meanings.note: + genitive. Core Russian prep meaning 'without' in everyday speech.

встать.gloss: to stand up, to get up

meanings.en: to stand up, to get up (out of bed)
meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'тать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to stand up, to get up', paired with 'вставать'.

examples.text: Кто первый встал, того и тапки.
examples.trans: First come, first served (whoever got up first gets the slippers).

examples.text: Юля, встала и пошла мыть посуду!
examples.trans: Yulia, get up and go wash the dishes!

meanings.note: Contrast дома = at home. Core Russian adv meaning '(to) home, homeward' in everyday speech.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: Asks about the purpose. Core Russian adv meaning 'what for, why' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: Oh, Samson. What have you come for?

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: In one direction, now. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to go (on foot)', paired with 'пойти'.

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.

meanings.note: Стоять на коленях = to kneel. Common neuter noun meaning 'knee' in everyday Russian.

meanings.en: to disgrace oneself, make a fool of oneself
meanings.note: Intransitive reflexive verb. Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'зориться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to disgrace oneself', paired with 'опозориться'.

examples.trans: Stop humiliating yourself in front of everyone!

examples.text: Он не хотел позориться на сцене.
examples.trans: He did not want to disgrace himself on stage.

examples.text: Встань прямо и не позорься тут.
examples.trans: Stand up straight and do not disgrace yourself here.

meanings.note: On foot. Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to go (set off)', paired with 'идти'.

examples.trans: Can I go and have a look?

meanings.note: On foot, once. Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to come, to arrive', paired with 'приходить'.

examples.trans: Security will be here any moment.

examples.text: Не надо, Самсон. Сейчас придёт охрана.
examples.trans: Don't, Samson. Security will be here any second.

examples.trans: Wait. Uncle Misha used to live in my room.

+ instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

examples.text: Я так два года потеряла. Любила так сильно!
examples.trans: I lost two years like that. I loved him so much!

meanings.note: comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

meanings.note: Direction. Core Russian adv meaning 'here (to this place)' in everyday speech.

examples.trans: The white one? Give me the keys.

meanings.note: + acc. Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'нижать'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to humiliate, belittle', paired with 'унизить'.

examples.trans: She is simply humiliating me in front of the children!

examples.text: Ты зачем так сильно унижал её?
examples.trans: Why did you humiliate her so much?

meanings.note: + infinitive or a noun. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to want', paired with 'захотеть'.
